hooks.name: Secret Scan on Commit
hooks.description: Blocks git commit/push if files matching secret patterns (.env, .pem, .key) are staged. Deterministic check.

action.command: powershell -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $json.toolInput.command; if ($cmd -match 'git\\s+(commit|push)') { $files = git -C 'D:/Pedro/AGROBO' diff --cached --name-only 2>$null; $secrets = $files | Where-Object { $_ -match '\\.(env|pem|key)$' -and $_ -notmatch '\\.example$' }; if ($secrets) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(\"BLOCKED: Potential secrets staged: $($secrets -join ', ')\"); exit 2 } else { exit 0 } } else { exit 0 }"
